back.example: Please be quiet, the baby is sleeping.

note: The hint is needed, because ruhig and leise also fit "quiet" (Sei ruhig! and Sei leise! are both common), and it does rule them out by pointing to English "still". A clearer wording would avoid hinting at the time sense of still (German noch), for example: "same word as English still (motionless), as in Sei ___!"
